label: coach_paldea_top_first_00
text: So this is the clubroom where this academy’s\nmost skilled Trainers gather...[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_first_01
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Thank you for your...kind invitation, Champion
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]. It’s an
honor
to
be here.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_sp01_00
text: Unfortunately, I do not have too much time. Let\nus put it to good use together.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_sp01_select_01
text: Thank you for coming

label: coach_paldea_top_sp01_select_02
text: I take it you’re busy?

label: coach_paldea_top_sp01_01
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Busy or not, refusing an invitation from you was\nout of the question, Champion\r\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_sp01_02
text: Do not worry too much, though—I had business\nwith the Unova Pokémon League, as well as some\r\nmatters to address with Director Cyrano.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_sp01_03
text: This is also an excellent opportunity to recruit\nnew, young talent to come to Paldea.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_sp01_04
text: With all that in mind, your invitation actually\ncame at quite an opportune moment.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_sp01_05
text: Ah, by the way... Ms. Briar informed me that your\npresence was invaluable for her expedition to the\r\nArea Zero Underdepths.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_sp01_06
text: This clubroom is a little too...public to discuss the\nmatter here, but please give me the details later.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_sp02_00
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Good day to you, Champion\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_sp02_01
text: I was just musing about potentially recruiting new\ntalent...[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_sp02_02
text: I would very much appreciate your input.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_sp02_03
text: Could you perhaps recommend a Trainer from\nBlueberry Academy whose talent you felt to be\r\nnoteworthy?[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_sp02_select_01
text: Kieran

label: coach_paldea_top_sp02_select_03
text: Carmine

label: coach_paldea_top_sp02_select_04
text: Crispin

label: coach_paldea_top_sp02_select_05
text: Amarys

label: coach_paldea_top_sp02_select_06
text: Lacey

label: coach_paldea_top_sp02_select_07
text: Drayton

label: coach_paldea_top_sp02_04
text:
Ah, yes, Kieran! The former Champion of the
BB League!\c
He was also part of the expedition to the
underdepths, if I am not mistaken.\c
He certainly has talent...and strong ties to you.
Perhaps we can convince him to move to Paldea.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_sp02_04b
text:
Ah, yes, Carmine! She was part of the expedition
to the underdepths, wasn’t she?\c
She has also accompanied Ms. Briar on other
extracurricular excursions. Such experience is
of great value.\c
And she has strong ties to you... We may be able
to convince her to move to Paldea.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_sp02_04c
text:
Ah, yes, Crispin! One of the BB League’s Elite
Four, if I am not mistaken.\c
We have no Fire-type users in our Pokémon
League, so he would certainly be a breath of
fresh air.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_sp02_04d
text:
Ah, yes, Amarys! One of the BB League’s Elite
Four, if I am not mistaken.\c
She is a Steel-type user, correct? I suppose she
would get along well with Poppy.\c
And her level-headed and intricate strategies
could shine well in Paldea...[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_sp02_04e
text:
Ah, yes, Lacey! One of the BB League’s Elite
Four, if I am not mistaken.\c
I hear her father is actually a Gym Leader in the
Unova region...\c
We also have a distinct lack of Fairy-type users
in our Pokémon League. I would very much like to
speak with her.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_sp02_04f
text:
Ah, yes, Drayton! One of the BB League’s Elite
Four, if I am not mistaken.\c
I hear his grandfather is a Gym Leader in the
Unova region...\c
And Drayton was the reigning Champion of the
BB League until Kieran dethroned him... A Trainer
of uncommon talent indeed.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_sp02_05
text: I had gathered information using my own sources,\nof course...[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_sp02_06
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]But your input is much appreciated, Champion
[VAR 0x0100(0000)].
It
was
most informative.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_sp03_00
text: If I may, Champion [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_sp03_01
text: I can’t help but notice that you seem to often be\nhere at Blueberry Academy in recent days...[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_sp03_02
text: Please forgive me if I am being paranoid, but...\c\nyou are not considering moving here to Unova\nfrom Paldea, are you?[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_sp03_select_01
text: I’m staying in Paldea

label: coach_paldea_top_sp03_select_02
text: Unova’s not bad...

label: coach_paldea_top_sp03_03
text: Ah, that is a relief to hear. I hope you’ll continue\nto be an inspiration to the people of our region.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_sp03_03b
text: I will, of course, respect your decision...\c\nBut personally, I very much hope you will stay in\nPaldea and be an inspiration to the people there.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_sp03_04
text: You are a guiding light that shines upon all of\nPaldea, after all...[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_trade_01_00
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]I have a proposition for you, Champion\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_trade_01_01
text: I want to demonstrate to you just how much I\ndepend on your presence.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_trade_01_02
text: Perhaps a Pokémon trade between the two of us\nwould help?[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_trade_01_03
text: I will be trading a Glimmet I caught in Area Zero.\c\nI hope through this trade you can somehow show\nme what you truly feel.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_trade_01_04
text: Thank you for trading with me.\c\nI am very curious to see how you raised this\n[VAR 0x0101(0001)] of yours...[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_trade_02_00
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]You will trade your [VAR 0x0101(0001)]
for
my
Glimmet, then?[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_trade_02_01
text: You can’t trade Geeta a Pokémon if you aren’t\nits original Trainer!

label: coach_paldea_top_trade_02_02
text: You can’t trade Geeta such a rare Pokémon!

label: coach_paldea_top_trade_02_03
text: You can’t trade Geeta a Shiny Pokémon!

label: coach_paldea_top_trade_03_00
text:
Ah, but you seem to only have one Pokémon
with you.\c
Please come back to me once you have at least
two Pokémon on your team.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_trade_03_01
text: I understand. You need to think carefully about\nwhich Pokémon to trade with me. I eagerly await\r\nyour decision.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_trade_04_00
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Are you ready to trade Pokémon, Champion\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_talkto_00
text: If you have a moment, would you care to battle\nme, Champion [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_cancel_00
text: Ah, that’s unfortunate. I am ready for a match\nwhenever the mood strikes you.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_battlestart_00
text: Wonderful! Let us make our way over to the\nacademy’s entrance, then.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_teacher_history_battlestart_01
text: [EMPTY 66]

label: coach_paldea_top_battleend_win_00_00
text: ...Magnificent as always. I see you’ve continued\nto hone your skills.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_battleend_win_00_01
text: That settles it for me. I no longer have any\ndoubts about my decision.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_battleend_win_00_02
text: There is something I very much wish for you\nto have.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_battleend_win_00_03
text: I hope you think carefully about why I chose to\ngive you those...[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_reward_00
text: You received the [VAR 0xFF00(0008)]Elite Gloves [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]from Geeta!

label: coach_paldea_top_battleend_win_01_00
text: Another wonderful battle. Please, take this—\njust something for your time.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_battleend_win_01_01
text: Regarding the gloves I gave you... Take your time\nto consider, but know that I await your reply.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_battleend_lose_00_00
text: An unusual slip-up for one of your talent.\c\nI do hope you manage to defeat me next time![VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_randomtalk_00
text:
A club emulating the organization and activities
of a Pokémon League—such an interesting idea.\c
I’ll be sure to discuss with Director Clavell and
see if we can’t begin something similar in Paldea.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_randomtalk_01
text:
I have been to the Zero Lab a few times myself...\c
but it never occurred to me to insert the Indigo
Disk into the panel by the entrance. You certainly
are good at thinking outside the box![VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_randomtalk_02
text:
The entrance to Blueberry Academy is so
original. It truly is a sight to behold.\c
Ah, I don’t mean to suggest our own academy’s
entrance is inferior, of course.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_randomtalk_03
text: About that [VAR 0x0101(0001)] you traded me...\c\nIt shows remarkable potential. I suppose it takes\nafter you, Champion [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: coach_paldea_top_randomtalk_04
text: I hope you are raising that Glimmet I traded you.\nI am certain she will serve you well.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]
